extracted.intended_audience: students and readers of philosophy/metaphysics (general educated audience)
extracted.subtask_short: philosophical analysis of love and life
extracted.subtask_description: Excerpts from a philosophical treatise discussing the metaphysics of love, the will to live, and the vanity and suffering of life; aimed at explaining how sexual desire and procreation relate to the will and to human unhappiness. Contains chapter-length argumentative prose rather than prescriptive evaluative criteria.
